title: $100 a month into Nvidia since 2010 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Nvidia since 2010.
Today that would be worth about {dca:NVDA:2010-01-04} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Nvidia price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Nvidia, starting in 2010.
Back then, Nvidia was making gaming chips.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:NVDA:2010-01-04}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
